metadata.question: Were the water levels in Lake Kariba in December, 2019 higher than the water levels seen in December, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Lake Kariba is located on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe (approximately -17.0°S, 28.0°E) - Need to compare water levels between December 2018 and December 2019 - Use JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR for water detection, or Sentinel-2/Landsat for water extent - Water extent analysis using NDWI or water occurrence would be appropriate 2. Masking strategy: - For optical data (Sentinel-2/Landsat): mask clouds to get clear water observations - Calculate water extent/area for both periods - More water area = higher water levels 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If water area calculation succeeds and shows measurable difference - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If all pixels masked out after cloud removal - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Lake Kariba geometry (approximate center and area) const lakeKariba = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[27.5, -16.5], [29.0, -16.5], [29.0, -17.5], [27.5, -17.5], [27.5, -16.5]] ]); // 2. Date ranges const date2018Start = '2018-12-01'; const date2018End = '2018-12-31'; const date2019Start = '2019-12-01'; const date2019End = '2019-12-31'; // 3. Load Sentinel-2 data for both periods let col2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeKariba) .filterDate(date2018Start, date2018End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); let col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeKariba) .filterDate(date2019Start, date2019End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 Images: ${size2018}`); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); // Fallback to Landsat 8 if Sentinel-2 fails if (size2018 === 0) { col2018 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeKariba) .filterDate(date2018Start, date2018End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); } if (size2019 === 0) { col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeKariba) .filterDate(date2019Start, date2019End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); } const finalSize2018 = col2018.size().getInfo(); const finalSize2019 = col2019.size().getInfo(); if (finalSize2018 === 0 || finalSize2019 === 0) { console.log('No data available for comparison'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 5. Calculate NDWI (water index) for both periods function addNDWI(image) { const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); return image.addBands(ndwi); } const img2018 = col2018.map(maskS2clouds).map(addNDWI).median(); const img2019 = col2019.map(maskS2clouds).map(addNDWI).median(); // 6. Calculate water area (NDWI > 0 indicates water) const water2018 = img2018.select('NDWI').gt(0); const water2019 = img2019.select('NDWI').gt(0); const area2018 = water2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeKariba, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const area2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeKariba, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Water pixels 2018: ${area2018}`); console.log(`Water pixels 2019: ${area2019}`); // 7. Validation and final answer if (area2018 === null || area2019 === null || area2018 === undefined || area2019 === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (area2018 === 0 && area2019 === 0) { console.log('No valid water pixels detected'); console.log('C2'); return; } const percentChange = ((area2019 - area2018) / area2018 * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (area2019 > area2018) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
